stem: Which sentence suggests that hammocks were helpful to explorers who traveled by sea?

options.label: A
options.text: People have been using hammocks for many years. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: They were small enough when folded that they could fit in small spaces on ships. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: He drew a picture of the knitted cotton rugs that natives hung between trees using twine strings. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: In 1889 a South Carolina riverboat captain named Joshua John Ward crafted a different type of hammock. (paragraph 6)
